title: Function and Scoliosis Surgery
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to examine the changes in function and performance biomechanics in patients undergoing spinal fusion corrective surgery for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of idiopathic scoliosis
* Patients identified to undergo spinal fusion surgery
* Treated at Duke University Medical Center

Exclusion Criteria:

* Neuromuscular or congenital scoliosis
study_population: Patients that are undergoing spinal fusion surgery to treat idiopathic scoliosis.
